title: 整数拆分最大乘积
description: 把 $n$（$n \ge 2$）拆成至少两个正整数之和，输出所有拆法中乘积的最大值。

solutions.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n0 = int(data[0])
d = [0] * (n0 + 1)
for v in range(2, n0 + 1):
    for q in range(1, v):
        d[v] = max(d[v], max(q, d[q]) * max(v - q, d[v - q]))
print(d[n0])
